# Junaid Hassan

> AI Automation Engineer and Legal Tech Specialist. Builds production-grade AI systems, full-stack SaaS products, and B2B automation — deployed solo, shipped to production, used by real businesses (not demos or prototypes).

Junaid Hassan is based in Wazirabad, Pakistan, and works with law firms and B2B companies globally on AI automation, legal technology, and custom software systems.

## Core Services

- AI Agents & Automation — custom AI workflows and agent systems for business processes
- Full-Stack SaaS Development — end-to-end product builds, from architecture to deployment
- Legal Tech — purpose-built software for law firms and legal operations teams

## Featured Work

- [Verity Legal](https://verity-legal-sc28.vercel.app): A real, production legal-tech SaaS platform built end-to-end, addressing document and workflow problems for legal practices.
